sacred_tallow.name: Sacred Tallow
sacred_tallow.lore: Burns bright. The dark pulls back.

greater_health_potion.name: Greater Health Potion
greater_health_potion.lore: Brewed by a hand that knew loss.

blood_cordial.name: Blood Cordial
blood_cordial.lore: It heals. It also remembers what fed it.

worn_dagger.name: Worn Dagger
worn_dagger.lore: A dull edge and a steady grip. Enough for the first steps down.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.lore: Forged for someone who never came back.

bone_hatchet.name: Bone Hatchet
bone_hatchet.lore: Hewn from a femur that disagreed.

hunters_bow.name: Hunter's Bow
hunters_bow.lore: The string still smells of pine resin and patience.

soulreaper_scythe.name: Soulreaper Scythe
soulreaper_scythe.lore: The harvest does not care for season.

witchfire_brand.name: Witchfire Brand
witchfire_brand.lore: Still warm. Even when set down.

frostbite_pick.name: Frostbite Pick
frostbite_pick.lore: Pulled from a glacier that no one mapped.

obsidian_shard.name: Obsidian Shard
obsidian_shard.lore: All edge, no balance. Just like its owner was.

mythril_blade.name: Mythril Blade
mythril_blade.lore: Cold to the touch even in a hot hand.

heartseeker_rapier.name: Heartseeker Rapier
heartseeker_rapier.lore: Finds the gap. Always the gap.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.lore: Light wood, lighter draw. The first lesson.

longbow.name: Longbow
longbow.lore: Made for someone with longer patience than arms.

crossbow.name: Crossbow
crossbow.lore: Loud as a curse, twice as final.

boomerang_bone.name: Bone Boomerang
boomerang_bone.lore: Carved from something that always returned home.

void_bow.name: Void Bow
void_bow.lore: Drawn without arrows. Arrives without warning.

leather_cap.name: Leather Cap
leather_cap.lore: Better than the cold scalp of the dead.

shadow_hood.name: Shadow Hood
shadow_hood.lore: Worn by those who preferred not to be seen praying.

horned_helm.name: Horned Helm
horned_helm.lore: The horns were already there. The smith just framed them.

veiled_circlet.name: Veiled Circlet
veiled_circlet.lore: The wearer hears words. Some of them their own.

tin_band.name: Tin Band
tin_band.lore: A token. Of what, nobody remembers.

bone_signet.name: Bone Signet
bone_signet.lore: A family seal. A family that ended here.

ring_of_vigor.name: Ring of Vigor
ring_of_vigor.lore: Warms the finger. Warms the heart, briefly.

ring_of_speed.name: Ring of Speed
ring_of_speed.lore: The hand wearing it acts a moment before the thought.

ring_of_the_called.name: Ring of the Called
ring_of_the_called.lore: Once worn by a king who answered.

padded_tunic.name: Padded Tunic
padded_tunic.lore: More comfortable than it looks. Less useful, too.

leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
leather_armor.lore: Stitched by a tailor with no eye for fashion.

scale_hauberk.name: Scale Hauberk
scale_hauberk.lore: Scales overlapped by patient, dead hands.

wraithcloak.name: Wraithcloak
wraithcloak.lore: Steps fall softer. So does sleep, eventually.

plated_mail.name: Plated Mail
plated_mail.lore: Heavier than it looks. The previous wearer is, too, somewhere down here.

bone_cuirass.name: Bone Cuirass
bone_cuirass.lore: The ribs were not yours. They are now.

cinder_robe.name: Cinder Robe
cinder_robe.lore: Lighter than ash. Older than fire.

ironheart_shard.name: Ironheart Shard
ironheart_shard.lore: A heart that learned to be stone.

heart_crystal.name: Heart Crystal
heart_crystal.lore: Beats in time with something that should not be alive.

tome_of_wisdom.name: Tome of Wisdom
tome_of_wisdom.lore: The pages turn themselves when no one watches.

ancient_codex.name: Ancient Codex
ancient_codex.lore: You do not read it. You let it read you.

strength_elixir.name: Strength Elixir

iron_skin_tonic.name: Iron Skin Tonic

berserkers_brew.name: Berserker's Brew

long_vigil_tea.name: Long Vigil Tea

phantom_vial.name: Phantom Vial
phantom_vial.lore: Slow, quiet, lasting. Like the dead.

plague_flask.name: Plague Flask

fire_bomb.name: Fire Bomb

voidshard.name: Voidshard

weapon_hollow_crossbow.lore: It clicks once for aim, once for judgement.

weapon_rift_rapier.lore: Thin enough to pass between seconds.

weapon_kingless_cleaver.name: Kingless Cleaver
weapon_kingless_cleaver.lore: Made for a feast that ended with no guests.

weapon_oathbreaker_scythe.name: Oathbreaker Scythe
weapon_oathbreaker_scythe.lore: A harvest tool sharpened on betrayal.

weapon_starseed_blade.name: Starseed Blade
weapon_starseed_blade.lore: It leaves blue afterimages in stale air.

weapon_voidglass_throwaxe.name: Voidglass Throwaxe
weapon_voidglass_throwaxe.lore: Returns only when it has heard your fear.

weapon_saintfall_spear.name: Saintfall Spear
weapon_saintfall_spear.lore: Balanced for a warrior who prayed standing.

weapon_abyssal_shardblade.name: Abyssal Shardblade
weapon_abyssal_shardblade.lore: It cuts light before it cuts flesh.

weapon_ebon_longbow.name: Ebon Longbow
weapon_ebon_longbow.lore: A bowstring pulled from the space between bells.

weapon_iron_choir_flail.name: Iron Choir Flail
weapon_iron_choir_flail.lore: A brutal hymn in one hand.

weapon_sundown_rapier.name: Sundown Rapier
weapon_sundown_rapier.lore: The last orange line before night wins.

weapon_cairn_splitter.name: Cairn Splitter
weapon_cairn_splitter.lore: Stone chips cling to its old edge.

weapon_deepbrand_sword.name: Deepbrand Sword
weapon_deepbrand_sword.lore: A cold blade that brightens near stairs.

helm_candlelit_sallet.name: Candlelit Sallet
helm_candlelit_sallet.lore: A narrow helm with soot inside the visor.

helm_mourner_crown.name: Mourner Crown
helm_mourner_crown.lore: Not royal. Just heavy with grief.

armor_sepulcher_coat.name: Sepulcher Coat
armor_sepulcher_coat.lore: Layered hide that smells faintly of rain.

armor_ash_warden_mail.name: Ash Warden Mail
armor_ash_warden_mail.lore: Scale links darkened by old fires.

ring_ring_of_low_stars.name: Ring of Low Stars
ring_ring_of_low_stars.lore: The gem shows a sky no one has seen.

ring_ring_of_bitter_vigor.name: Ring of Bitter Vigor
ring_ring_of_bitter_vigor.lore: It tightens whenever death gets ideas.

helm_veilguard_hood.name: Veilguard Hood
helm_veilguard_hood.lore: Soft cloth sewn with watcher knots.

ring_ring_of_the_third_stair.name: Ring of the Third Stair
ring_ring_of_the_third_stair.lore: It hums when a stairwell is near.

armor_last_vigil_plate.name: Last Vigil Plate
armor_last_vigil_plate.lore: Built to hold the line after the line is gone.

helm_deepwarden_barbute.name: Deepwarden Barbute
helm_deepwarden_barbute.lore: Its mouth slit is shaped like a locked gate.

armor_moon_eaten_cloak.lore: A cloak that moves half a breath late.

ring_ring_of_quiet_bells.name: Ring of Quiet Bells
ring_ring_of_quiet_bells.lore: You feel the impact before hearing it.

helm_sable_saint_mask.name: Sable Saint Mask
helm_sable_saint_mask.lore: A saint wore it once. The stain disagrees.

armor_abyss_tempered_plate.name: Abyss Tempered Plate
armor_abyss_tempered_plate.lore: Too heavy for fear to shake loose.

consumable_lantern_sap.name: Lantern Sap
consumable_lantern_sap.lore: Sticky light that seals shallow wounds.

consumable_blackroot_tonic.name: Blackroot Tonic
consumable_blackroot_tonic.lore: Tastes like soil under a grave marker.

consumable_saints_breath.name: Saints Breath
consumable_saints_breath.lore: A clear vial that fogs when held by liars.

consumable_war_ash_elixir.name: War Ash Elixir
consumable_war_ash_elixir.lore: Bites the tongue and steadies the hand.

consumable_moonmilk_flask.name: Moonmilk Flask
consumable_moonmilk_flask.lore: Pale and sweet, like mercy remembered wrong.

consumable_gravewater.name: Gravewater
consumable_gravewater.lore: Cold enough to make pain step back.

consumable_prophets_ink.name: Prophets Ink
consumable_prophets_ink.lore: The dungeon briefly forgets how to hide.

consumable_bloodwarm_phial.name: Bloodwarm Phial
consumable_bloodwarm_phial.lore: Too hot for glass, too useful to refuse.

consumable_eclipse_cordial.name: Eclipse Cordial
consumable_eclipse_cordial.lore: For one swallow, the dark calls you kin.

consumable_kingsroot_draught.name: Kingsroot Draught
consumable_kingsroot_draught.lore: A root that grew around a buried crown.

consumable_last_ember_cordial.name: Last Ember Cordial
consumable_last_ember_cordial.lore: A final warmth saved in glass.

throwable_cinder_bomb.name: Cinder Bomb
throwable_cinder_bomb.lore: The fuse whispers old prayers backward.

throwable_glass_sun_grenade.name: Glass Sun Grenade
throwable_glass_sun_grenade.lore: A little sunrise with no mercy.

throwable_mire_flask.name: Mire Flask
throwable_mire_flask.lore: It breaks, and the floor starts breathing.

throwable_bell_iron_bomb.name: Bell Iron Bomb
throwable_bell_iron_bomb.lore: The blast leaves a ringing shape in the air.

charm_charred_saints_finger.name: Charred Saints Finger
charm_charred_saints_finger.lore: A last chance curled into ash.

charm_pocket_reliquary.name: Pocket Reliquary
charm_pocket_reliquary.lore: It clicks shut whenever something unseen passes.

charm_black_choir_page.name: Black Choir Page
charm_black_choir_page.lore: The notation hurts to read aloud.

charm_map_of_the_sleeping_deep.name: Map of the Sleeping Deep
charm_map_of_the_sleeping_deep.lore: The ink rearranges when you blink.
